facts.business: Alicon Castalloy Limited is a Pune-headquartered integrated manufacturer of precision aluminium castings, serving automotive (two, three, four-wheeler OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers) and non-automotive sectors including infrastructure, defence, aerospace, energy, agriculture, carbon-neutral technologies, and data centre components across 18 countries.
